widgets_values: An unedited documentary photograph taken with an ordinary full-frame camera, exposed for the actual light of the scene, with soft true-to-life colors; the brightness, shadow direction, and haze toward the distance stay consistent across the sky, the road, and every roadside object. The asphalt shows everyday wear such as tire tracks, patched sections, small cracks, and slightly faded lane paint.

nodes.title: 画像スタイル：アニメ / Image style: Anime
widgets_values: A 2D anime background painting with richly detailed painted skies and clouds, finely textured asphalt with worn white lane paint, crisp reflections on the road surface, strong light halation and deep shadows, delicate highlights on the roadside scenery, floating light particles, and vivid colors.

The horizon sits slightly below the middle of the frame: the road surface spreads across the frame below it, and the roadside scenery and sky fill the space above it. The lane's white boundary lines start at equal distances to the left and right of the frame center at the bottom edge and converge toward a vanishing point near the center of the frame, with the other lanes and the center line extending to the {e}. {b} The roadside scenery stands beyond the road shoulders, set back from the lane, and rises at a natural scale beside the road on both sides. integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] {a}, a forward view along the road shown in <Picture 1>, preserving its composition, lighting, colors, road markings, and scenery. {b} The camera pushes in continuously at a steady cruising speed, traveling along the middle of the {c} lane at the same low height with a level horizon and following the road as it continues ahead. The lane markings stream toward the bottom of the frame, and the roadside scenery on both sides grows larger as it approaches and slides out past the left and right edges of the frame, moving with the road surface in natural parallax: nearby objects pass quickly while the distant view near the vanishing point draws slowly closer.

overall_soundscape: Steady road noise from tires rolling on asphalt and a low engine hum continue throughout the video, with wind rushing past the moving car.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
